page.layout: One page of text in a single main column on the right; a narrow marginal note column on the left with one side note ("Sacrar.cerem. l.1."). Running head at top. Page number at top left. Catchword "copo" at bottom right of the text block.

main_text.p: ad blandientes intueri : Etiam vbi de rebus medijs lis est, conciliandorum animos quadam tenus conspirare oportet; neque sat est alteram partem vnà cum armis, odium deposuisse: Hoc verò quî tandem ferent Romani ? Eteoclenum profecto odium, aut Vatinianum, merus amor est præ hoc Pontificio : Ecce nos vbi non, quando non conspuimur, vt hæreticissimi Ecclesiæ hostes? Iudæos in sinum suum admittit Roma, quorum etiam è manibus Pontifex legem accipere non dedignatur, Euangelicos non fert ; Quod à Theodosio Synadorum Episcopo

page.notes: Left margin note "Sacrar.cerem. l.1." is printed beside the column. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored. The text runs off at the foot of the column ("Episcopo" is cut by the column end in the scan, read as "Epis-" with continuation not visible on this page; the last word is printed as "Epis-"). Faint marginal traces near the left edge were not read.
